scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run content:snapshot && npm run build
scripts.preview: npm run content:snapshot && opennextjs-cloudflare build && opennextjs-cloudflare preview
scripts.deploy: npm run deploy:database && npm run content:snapshot:live && opennextjs-cloudflare build && opennextjs-cloudflare deploy && node scripts/after-deploy.mjs
scripts.deploy:database: CLOUDFLARE_ENV=migrate CLOUDFLARE_REMOTE_BINDINGS=true NODE_ENV=production PAYLOAD_SECRET=ignore payload migrate && wrangler d1 execute D1 --command 'PRAGMA optimize' --remote
scripts.generate:types: wrangler types --env-interface CloudflareEnv cloudflare-env.d.ts && payload generate:types
scripts.content:snapshot:live: CLOUDFLARE_ENV=migrate CLOUDFLARE_REMOTE_BINDINGS=true PAYLOAD_SECRET=ignore payload run scripts/content-snapshot.ts
